::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
One of the largest semiconductor-focused investments in Tamil Nadu to date, and a marker of India moving beyond chip design into equipment technology-development and manufacturing-support infrastructure — KLA is the process-control/metrology equipment leader, a segment India had essentially no domestic presence in.
:::

## What does this facility supply?

Advanced semiconductor R&D — process-control and metrology engineering, innovation, next-generation manufacturing technology development. Expected to create up to 4,000 jobs.

## Key Facts

| | |
|---|---|
| **Category** | Equipment Manufacturer |
| **Parent Company** | KLA Corporation (United States) |
| **Location** | Chennai, Tamil Nadu |
| **Investment** | ₹3,600 crore / $400M |
| **Status** | Announced |
| **Supplies** | General / not tied to one facility |

## Project Timeline

- **13 Feb 2026** — KLA signs MoU with Tamil Nadu's Guidance TN investment agency for a $400M (~₹3,600cr) Chennai R&D and Innovation Campus
